name: Toast
structurePatterns: floating pill at bottom of viewport above bottom nav/CTA, with 16px inset
horizontal: optional status icon + single-line message + optional action
dark inverse surface; status meaning carried by icon shape + message (not low-contrast chroma foreground)
when an action exists it uses accent cyan (snackbar-style recovery action)
usageHints: transient non-action feedback: no action for plain Toast; one recovery action = Snackbar variant
never use for field validation (that belongs inline under the field)
merge or replace bursts instead of stacking a message wall
critical information must not depend on auto-dismiss
placement avoids keyboard, safe area, bottom navigation and CTA
doNotInvent: no primary-filled action button inside toast
unknowns: auto-dismiss duration handled by motion/platform layer
